reviews.text: Felt safe leaving my ATV and trailer there… especially with a gate at the entry.

reviews.author: Kara
reviews.label: July 2026
reviews.text: My three boys especially enjoyed the zip line and trampoline… everything around there can be accessed on a SxS.

reviews.author: Brittney
reviews.label: June 2026
reviews.text: The property was very pretty and clean, tons of space… the creek right behind the cabin has lots of cool rocks and crystals! The kids had a lot of fun fishing in the pond and catching bass. They also really enjoyed the trampoline and the zip line. The cabin itself was beautiful inside… They had everything you could need in the kitchen. We had a fantastic time and the host was very responsive. I would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Charles & Sherry
reviews.label: June 2026
reviews.text: The Stargazer cabin in the woods was a perfect place to relax and enjoy the Ouachita National Forest all around you. It was quiet, peaceful and provided direct ATV access to the trail system. The cabin was very clean and stocked with all the essentials… perfect size for 2 couples and 2 kids. The host Simao was very attentive and responded to our questions quickly. We would definitely recommend this cabin.

reviews.author: Shawn
reviews.label: March 2026
reviews.text: The cabin is awesome!! The remote location is easy to find and you get so much outdoor space… Definitely worth the drive from Dallas to spend 4 nights and 3 days riding SxS. Its location allows you to get to everything you want to ride. Host is awesome and really communicates at a high level.
